detail.title: GP110R Wired Gamepad with Neon RGB - D-Input & X-Input
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GP110R is a wired gamepad with a transparent shell that shows off its internal RGB lighting and rumble motors for a striking, geek-friendly look. Dual precision analog joysticks with textured rubber grips give accurate control for shooters, racing titles and action games alike, while turbo and programmable button support add a competitive edge. It supports both D-Input and X-Input modes on Windows, along with PS3, Nintendo Switch, Android TV boxes and Android media boxes, making it a genuinely versatile controller across PC and console setups. A true plug-and-play USB 2.0 connection means no drivers are needed, and the ergonomic curved shell with anti-slip texture keeps hands comfortable through long gaming sessions.
